Here are two great value-for-money options based on our plans:

Essentials Medium

Price: $159
Includes: 6 cuts, up to 21 lbs of meat.
Cuts: Over 50 core cuts (e.g., ground beef, chicken breasts, pork chops), but no specialty cuts like ribeye, filet mignon, or scallops.
Best for: Saving money while still getting a solid variety of everyday staples.

Signature Medium

Price: $179
Includes: 6 cuts, up to 21 lbs of meat.
Cuts: Same 50+ core cuts plus access to 30+ specialty cuts (e.g., ribeye, filet mignon, scallops) and a broader overall selection.
Best for: Maximum variety and access to premium/specialty proteins at a still-reasonable price.

Comparison in plain terms

Think of Essentials Medium as the “smart-budget pantry stocker” – everyday proteins at the lowest price per box.
Signature Medium is like upgrading to the “full menu” – same box size and weight range, but for $20 more you unlock premium steaks and seafood options.

Both plans:

Let you build your own box by choosing your cuts before each billing.
Include access to member deals, add-ons, and full account flexibility (you can change box type, delivery frequency, and more before your next bill date).

So, if you want strictly best price, go Essentials Medium. If you want best overall value for flexibility + premium choices, go Signature Medium.
